data.name: WellPlanet Project
data.description: WellPlanet is a direct air capture and sequestration company partnering with organizations, companies, and investors to remove CO2. The Panama City Beach, Florida-based startup has been working to capitalize on its venture to create the world's largest capture and sequestration facility, but public content appears frozen at 2022 with no evidence of an operating facility, funding milestones, or registry activity.
